description: Exact Spring MVC write endpoint census plus service-layer authorization semantics. Endpoint rows are reviewed policy, not generated defaults.

analysisModel.endpointEvidence: Exact Spring MVC method/path/handler census, merged @PreAuthorize operation guard, and reviewed source/runtime operation bindings.
analysisModel.serviceEvidence: Comment-stripped lexical method-body census for SecurityUtil helpers, explicit manual-deny sites, and query/credential guards.
knownLimits: Static service checks prove required guard statements remain in the registered method, not full Java control-flow reachability.
EXTERNAL Actuator/SockJS declarations are bound to source/runtime policy and HTTP authentication wiring; this is not a full framework transport census or live DB measurement.

Historical ADMIN policy labels preserve the resource-policy taxonomy. Current access requires exact operation permissions; group names and display role fields do not confer privileges. Existing owner, participant and privacy restrictions remain additional requirements.

policyDefinitions.AUTHENTICATED: Any current enabled, nonlocked canonical principal, including zero assigned groups; no resource-owner assertion is claimed.
policyDefinitions.STRICT_SELF: The endpoint binds the target identifier to the current principal; no arbitrary target selector or administrator bypass is exposed by that endpoint.
policyDefinitions.SELF_WITH_CREDENTIAL: Principal-bound self service plus current credential proof.
policyDefinitions.STRICT_OWNER: Resource owner/participant only; administrator bypass is forbidden by the service guard.
policyDefinitions.OWNER_OR_ADMIN: Resource owner or the exact operation-specific override permission registered on the service helper; historical ADMIN label does not imply group inheritance.
policyDefinitions.PARTICIPANT_OR_ADMIN: Named resource participant or the exact operation-specific override permission; group names alone do not grant access.
policyDefinitions.REACHABILITY_WITH_PRIVACY: Owner/shared reachability; operation override permissions cannot bypass personal-reference privacy.
policyDefinitions.ADMIN_OR_SYSTEM: Historical managed-resource label; current method, HTTP and service guards require the explicit operation permission, without role hierarchy.
policyDefinitions.ADMIN_ROLE_WITH_HIERARCHY: Historical administrative endpoint label retained for registry compatibility; current authorization uses the exact operation permission and no role inheritance.
policyDefinitions.SYSTEM_ACCOUNT_IMMUTABLE: Invariant deny protecting the system re-assignment account.
